title: Orion Manufacturing onboarding & acceptance pack
pinned_prompts: System: You are a manufacturing process assistant. Task: summarize the assembly step and call out safety checks. Input: <assembly_step_description>. Output: concise bullet list of actions (3-6 bullets) + 1-2 safety flags.
System: You are a quality-assurance reviewer. Task: given a test log, return a one-paragraph diagnosis and suggested next steps, include likely root cause keywords.
System: You are a technical writer. Task: rewrite the short SOP fragment into a verified checklist for floor technicians at 4th-grade reading level.
System: You are a procurement assistant. Task: extract part numbers and quantities from semi-structured vendor email text and output JSON-like lines: PART|QTY|NOTES.
System: You are a troubleshooting assistant. Task: given sensor telemetry (time series summary) and a failure description, list 3 likely failure modes ranked by probability.
System: You are a compliance summarizer. Task: read the provided regulatory clause and produce a single-line compliance action and a 1-sentence risk note.
private_datasets: orion_qc_logs_2023 (tabular logs, sensor traces, 42k rows) - csv export: gs://redwood-private/orion/qc_logs_2023.csv
vendor_emails_anon_2024 (vendor correspondence, PII redacted) - docx bundle: gs://redwood-private/orion/vendor_emails_anon_2024.zip
acceptance_criteria: Functional correctness: >85% task-level pass rate across pinned prompt set (see per-prompt scoring rubric below).
Hallucination: fewer than 3% factual hallucinations on structured extraction tasks (vendor_emails, part extraction).
Safety/regulatory: zero critical compliance misclassifications on the compliance test shard (critical = omission of required action).
Latency: median token-to-token latency <= 18ms on dedicated-hosted benchmark (13B quantized variant).
Cost: tokenized unit cost not to exceed baseline by more than 20% for q4f variant under 99th-percentile traffic profile.
Regression delta: no more than -1.5% absolute change in pass rate vs baseline for any prompt category between candidate and baseline variant.
regression_plan: 1) Snapshot baseline: run full harness on baseline variant and store baseline metrics + seed (artifact: baseline_snapshot_2024-11-10).
2) Run candidate variants: execute evaluation harness on all listed candidate models with identical seeds and batching config.
3) Differential analysis: compute per-example flips, identify top 50 examples with largest score regression, produce manual triage notes.
4) Targeted fuzz tests: run 5k paraphrase perturbations for each pinned prompt and measure robustness (expectation: robustness score >= 0.80).
5) Safety sweep: run compliance prompt set with adversarial paraphrases and filter any critical failures for SR triage.
6) Signoff gate: require applied-ml lead + customer PM signoff for production rollout (see signoff checklist).
signoff: Sofia Martinez (Applied ML Lead) - technical signoff
Rina Patel (Customer Success, Orion) - customer acceptance
Priya Kapoor (QA engineer) - test coverage signoff
body:
Purpose:
This document is the customer-specific onboarding and acceptance pack for Orion Manufacturing. It captures the pinned prompts, private dataset references, acceptance thresholds, regression gating plan, and the signoff checklist required before we enable dedicated capacity in the Orion VPC. The pack is intentionally conservative on hallucination and safety thresholds given regulated SOPs and on-floor safety implications.

Quick background and constraints:
- Customer: Orion Manufacturing (discrete manufacturing, mid-sized, heavy automation lines).
- Primary workloads: automated SOP generation, QC log triage, procurement extraction, and frontline troubleshooting assistance.
- Data sensitivity: vendor PII redacted; some supply chain confidential fields require KMS-managed access to dataset artifacts.

Evaluation harness (how to run):
- Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/orion-eval-harness (linked above).
- Baseline command (example):
  python run_eval.py --model redwood/llama-3-13b-q4f --dataset gs://redwood-private/orion/manifests/v1/index.csv --seed 42 --batch-size 8 --out artifacts/baseline_q4f.jsonl
- Important flags: --force-deterministic-seed, --enable-kv-cache=false (to mirror production single-token latency), --safety-paraphrase-seed for adversarial generation.

Scoring rubric (per prompt):
- Extraction tasks (procurement/part extraction): exact match micro-F1; full credit for exact matches, partial credit for subset matches; acceptance threshold: 85% EM-equivalent at row-level.
- Summarization/diagnosis tasks: two-part evaluation: (a) semantic similarity vs gold (ROUGE-L >= 0.45) AND (b) human pass/fail label for safety-critical items (>= 90% pass).
- SOP checklist rewrite: readability (FK grade <= 6) + checklist completeness (annotator pass rate >= 88%).
- Troubleshooting ranking: top-3 recall >= 0.78; calibration score within 0.1 RMSE of baseline.

Manual triage and labeling notes:
- The gold sets in sop_fragments_gold include dual annotator labels + adjudication notes. When we find borderline failures, escalate to Rina (CS) for domain clarification.
- For vendor_emails_anon_2024, include a small human verification pass (200 samples) to sanity-check part-number normalization.

Known risks and mitigations:
- Risk: model over-confidently invents part numbers from free text. Mitigation: add strict regex-based post-filter and fallback to "needs human review" when confidence < 0.55 for structured extraction.
- Risk: SOP rewrite might remove mandatory safety steps. Mitigation: include an automated safety-keyword detector with a whitelist of required steps; failure triggers forced human review.

Deliverables for signoff:
- Evaluation artifact bundle (artifacts/*.jsonl) with per-example labels and model outputs.
- Regression analysis report (HTML/CSV) with per-prompt deltas and example triage notes.
- Short demo runbook and sample API contract for Orion's integration team.

Signoff checklist (must be completed):
- [ ] Baseline snapshot artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-private/orion/artifacts/baseline_snapshot_2024-11-10
- [ ] Candidate run artifacts for each variant present and validated checksums
- [ ] Adversarial safety sweep executed and critical failures triaged
- [ ] Customer-facing demo prepared and acceptance script approved by Rina
- [ ] Legal: NDA validation and data handling checklist confirmed by Security

Notes and outstanding questions:
- Customer asked for a monthly regression alert email; engineering to propose an initial template and ownership.
- Confirm whether Orion requires on-prem KMS integration for long-term artifact retention; ticket raised: JIRA-AM-7891.

Appendix: quick examples (from pinned prompts)
1) Input (assembly step): "Align bracket to chassis, torque bolts B1-B4 to 12Nm, verify sensor X12 LED green."
   Expected output: "- Position bracket on chassis
- Torque bolts B1,B2,B3,B4 to 12Nm
- Verify sensor X12 LED is green (if not, stop and call maintenance)
Safety flags: torque step, sensor verification"

2) Vendor email fragment: "Please ship 200 units of P/N 11-AC-332, ETA 2024-11-14. PO: 001122. Note: packaging change noted."
   Expected extraction lines: "11-AC-332|200|PO:001122; packaging change noted"

If anything in this pack needs clarification or you want additional adversarial cases, tag the linked PR or ping the applied-ml Slack channel (#applied-ml-orion).
